related_work_framing.comparable_axis: A smaller or cheaper model/scaffold answers from a compact retrieved evidence pack.
related_work_framing.non_comparable_axis: This project requires dated/evolving-KB splits, inline evidence citations, support-aware abstention, and judged citation-grounded correctness rather than answer-only utility.

systems.interpretation: Closest available generic direct-RAG student baseline: compact evidence pack in, answer with citations out, no support-aware post-training beyond local citation-contract repair.
A cheap amortized scaffold can improve judged correctness over direct repair, but it does so by suppressing answers and losing answer/citation recall.
A true zero-call local scaffold trained from distilled labels is cheap but underpowered on the final window: it over-abstains and has weak answer F1/recall.
Distilling to a span selector improves coverage over the extractive floor, but judged answer support remains low because selected spans can be topically relevant without answering the question.
Naive local SFT on compact RAG labels can learn to emit cited answers but does not preserve support, showing why the paper needs support-aware joint-action data rather than generic SFT.

synthesis.headline: Generic RAG distillation is an insufficient baseline unless it is judged on support and abstention under temporal update splits.
observations: The direct-mini RAG student plus citation repair reaches 72.5% GPT-4o judged correctness and 64.2% answer support, but still leaves unsupported answered claims.
A zero-call risk gate improves overall judged correctness to 79.7% and answer support to 70.5%, but answers fewer examples and loses reference recall/F1.

Zero-call distilled local scaffolds are materially cheaper but not competitive: the extractive scaffold answers 22/69 with 6.1% answer F1, while the span scaffold answers 52/69 but only 19.2% of answered spans are judged supported.
The local Qwen 0.5B answer-repeat SFT result demonstrates the generic-SFT failure mode: 97.5% inline citation compliance with only 5.0% answer support.
synthesis.conclusion_for_paper: A DRAG-like comparison should be framed as a close baseline family, but the novel target is support-preserving data construction over evolving/private KBs. The next model result must show whether joint-action SFT/DPO improves support without relying on per-query teacher or verifier calls.
true_drag_reproduction_needed: Implement DRAG's exact teacher/student protocol if a reviewer asks for apples-to-apples reproduction.
Evaluate it on the same final dated/private KB window with the same GPT-4o support judge.
Report answer support, abstention support, citation precision/recall, and total inference cost rather than answer F1 alone.

llm_budget.note: This comparison reuses existing prediction and judge artifacts; it makes no new API calls and creates no GPU job.
